subject.title: feat(talk): describe_view inline vision for OpenAI Realtime + Gemini Live

question: Should OpenClaw accept a browser-direct `describe_view` MVP for Control UI Video Talk, and if so what camera permission boundary must it use before merge?
rationale: The patch changes browser camera permission and provider-direct image-data handling, and automation cannot choose the permanent consent/security boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Scope And Prove Browser-Direct MVP
options.body: Keep the shared Gateway default at `camera=()`, add a narrow Control UI-only camera permission path, align provider denial behavior, and require redacted real browser/provider proof before merge.

options.title: Approve Broader Same-Origin Camera Access
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally accept `camera=(self)` globally only after security review confirms every same-origin Gateway response should be camera-capable.

options.title: Pause For Transport Design
options.body: Pause this browser-direct PR if maintainers want the provider/gateway video-frame contract settled first through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89131.

recommendation.title: Scope And Prove Browser-Direct MVP
recommendation.body: Keep the shared Gateway default at `camera=()`, add a narrow Control UI-only camera permission path, align provider denial behavior, and require redacted real browser/provider proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is assigned to this PR and has the strongest current history in the Talk/UI/provider surfaces affected by the decision.
